name: log_follow_read
title: Read New Log Entries
description: Returns only new log bytes appended since cursor. Use the handle returned by log_follow_start.

handle.description: Opaque log-follow handle returned by log_follow_start.

cursor.description: Byte offset to resume from; pass back the cursor from the previous call.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to return; newer entries remain available.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null for handle-scoped calls).

cursor.description: Resume offset for the next call.

eof.description: Whether the read reached end of file.

truncatedReset.description: True when log rotation reset the cursor.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
